apps.heading: Your applications
apps.refreshPrompt: Refresh status to see the applications selected for this workspace.
apps.legacyStatus: This server connector provides legacy status. Connect the current local StackKits CLI to view application evidence; server diagnostics remain available below.
apps.unavailable: Application status is unavailable. See the diagnostic output and refresh the selected workspace.
apps.requestFailed: The status request failed. Check the connector and retry.
apps.none: This plan has no selected application workloads.
apps.setup.prepareWith: Prepare {file} with {fields}. Keep the file private; this console never receives its contents.
apps.setup.prepareGuide: Prepare {file} using the setup guide. Keep the file private; this console never receives its contents.
apps.setup.manual: Setup remains manual for this application; follow its product onboarding guide.
kit.heading: Explicit StackKit Configuration
kit.label: StackKit
kit.note.before: This preset editor uses the explicit v2alpha1 compatibility contract. For native module-local profiles, prepare and review your configuration in the
kit.note.after: , then load its authored StackSpec here. The State Console does not recommend or select a Kit.
domain.heading: Governed Override and Observed Inventory
domain.note.plan.before: ResolvedPlan is persisted at the canonical
domain.note.plan.after: path used by every later stage.
domain.note.inventory: Inventory is externally observed. Do not enter provider credentials, lifecycle, SSH transport, or management addresses into StackSpec.
review.heading: Review and Plan
review.noReplace: Initial authoring is no-replace. Replacing existing v2 intent requires its exact CUE-normalized expected spec hash.
review.approveMutations: I approve the explicitly named local Init, Resolve, and Generate operations shown in this flow.
rollout.heading: Operation Approval and Evidence
rollout.applyReviewed: I reviewed the current plan and want the agent to request Apply approval
rollout.verifyHttp: Runtime HTTP evidence is separate from plan verification
output.noToolCalls: This host does not expose Apps SDK tool calls in the widget context.
output.approvalRequired: Explicit local Owner approval is required before requesting Init, Resolve, or Generate.
output.migrationMessage: StackSpec v1 is migration input only and was not loaded into the v2 editor.
output.needSpecPlan: Create or load a canonical StackSpec v2 before resolving and planning.
output.planHalted: Plan flow stopped after the first failed MCP step.
output.needSpecRollout: Create or load a canonical StackSpec v2 before running the governed flow.
output.reviewPlanFirst: Review the current plan before requesting Apply approval.
output.applyNever: The State Console never invokes Apply directly. Ask the connected agent to present the registered StackKits Apply operation for operation-specific confirmation and Owner approval.
output.setupNever: The State Console does not invoke setup directly. Prepare the private credential file, then ask the connected agent to present this registered setup operation for confirmation.
